headline: Approved grant application for new police vehicles, continued employment of police and fire chiefs, and an assistant fire chief appointment.
summary: Fire Chief Carter gave an update on promotions, equipment, and storm response. Minority Leader Anthony voiced concern that the assistant fire chief job was not filled internally. Two members of the public spoke.
decisions: Approved applying for and, if awarded, accepting and spending funds from the 2026 Edward Byrne Memorial Justice Assistance Grant, unanimously with 0 opposed and 0 abstentions.
Approved continued employment of Edward Page Reynolds as Chief of Police, 5 in favor, 0 opposed, 2 abstentions.
Approved continued employment of Shelly Carter as Fire Chief, 6 in favor, 0 opposed, 1 abstention.
Approved appointment of Jermaine B. Atkinson as Assistant Fire Chief, 6 in favor, 0 opposed, 1 abstention.

plain_text:
TOWN OF HAMDEN, 
CONNECTICUT 
 
PUBLIC SAFETY COMMITTEE 
MINUTES DRAFT 
 
 
 
 
Committee Chair: 
Present - Adrian Webber 
Committee Vice Chair: 
Present - Tasha Hunt 
Committee Members: 
Present - Sean Cardwell 
Present - Maurine Crouch 
Present - Tom Figlar 
Present - Sarah Gallagher, Majority Leader 
Present - Bob Anthony, Minority Leader 
Absent - Katie Kiely, President 
 
 
   
1. CALL OF THE MEETING AND TAKING OF THE ROLL 
Public Safety Committee Meeting, September 28, 2026 – 7pm.  The meeting was opened 
by Vice Chair Hunt at 9:11pm with the members noted above in attendance.  
  
  
2. PUBLIC INPUT SESSION 
Two members of the public came forward to speak. The Public Input session was closed 
at 9:17pm. 
    
3. REPORT OF DEPARTMENTS, BOARDS, AND COMMISSIONS 
Vice Chair Hunt noted the upcoming Fire and Police Commission meetings and pointed 
out the Police Department Report that had been submitted.  Fire Chief Carter gave a 
report on recent leadership promotions within the Fire Department, noting vacancies had 
been filled at the battalion chief, captain, and lieutenant levels.  She also provided updates 
on the Department’s ongoing apparatus and equipment needs, emergency management 
response to recent storm, firefighter training and wellness initiatives, and efforts to secure 
grant funding to support department needs. 
  
4. COMMITTEE REGULAR AGENDA  
  1. ORDER AUTHORIZING THE TOWN OF HAMDEN TO APPLY AND IF AWARDED 
ACCEPT AND EXPEND FUNDS FROM THE 2026 EDWARD BYRNE MEMORIAL 
JUSTICE ASSISTANCE GRANT FROM THE U.S. DEPARTMENT OF JUSTICE 
 
MOTION: Webber 
SECOND: Parks 
 
Chief Reynolds shared that this grant, along with the other one previously approved 
by Council, will be used to purchase new marked police vehicles to replace aging 
fleet vehicles and support public safety operations. He also noted the Department's 
ongoing efforts to secure grant funding to offset equipment costs and reduce the 
financial impact on the Town. 
 
VOTE: All in favor, 0 opposed, 0 abstentions. Unanimous
APPROVED ITEMS RECEIVED FROM THIS EVENING'S SUBMISSION 
CALENDAR 
  3. 
ORDER APPROVING THE CONTINUED EMPLOYMENT OF EDWARD PAGE 
REYNOLDS CHIEF OF POLICE 
MOTION: Figlar 
SECOND: Parks 
VOTE: 5 in favor, 0 opposed, 2 abstentions (Anthony/Figlar)  
  4. 
ORDER APPROVING THE CONTINUED EMPLOYMENT OF SHELLY CARTER 
FIRE CHIEF 
MOTION: Parks 
SECOND: Figlar 
VOTE: 6 in favor, 0 opposed, 1 abstention (Anthony)  
  5. 
ORDER PROVIDING FOR THE APPOINTMENT OF A MAYORAL APPOINTMENT 
JERMAINE B. ATKINSON- ASSISTANT FIRE CHIEF 
MOTION: Parks 
SECOND: Webber 
Minority Leader Anthony expressed his concern that the position was not filled 
internally.  
VOTE: 6 in favor, 0 opposed, 1 abstention (Anthony) 
 
******************** 
ANNOUNCEMENT: 
Vice Chair Hunt announced the upcoming Hamden Back to School Carnival and 
encouraged residents to attend and help spread the word. She noted that the event 
provides an opportunity to support Hamden schools and the community.  
 
5. COMMITTEE NEW BUSINESS 
There was no new business for this evening’s meeting.  
  
6. COMMITTEE UNFINISHED BUSINESS 
There was no unfinished business for this evening’s meeting. 
  
7. ADJOURN 
With no additional business before the Committee, Vice Chair Hunt adjourned the meeting 
at 9:41pm.
